corrections.reason: The blind-field wagering-accuracy correlation is reported as r=.30, but the supplied article does not report an adequate direct positive test of that correlation against zero. The between-field correlation difference supports an awareness-linked metacognitive difference but cannot establish positive blind-field metacognitive capacity.

structural_non_regression_expectations.expectation: Before scalar component rows are finalized, assess and instantiate the focal factorial-functional comparison when the awareness x cue-feature-relation x target-location interaction tests one coherent spatial-cuing mapping. Component capacity rows may coexist but may not replace that focal comparison.
structural_non_regression_expectations.old_pilot_violation: The pilot instantiated attentional-capture and feature-change-cost scalar rows without a durable pre-atomization assessment or focal factorial comparison.
